options.product: ZITADEL Cloud - applications and SCIM user provisioning
options.plan: Cloud entitlement and deployed version not verified
options.configuration: Documentation research only; not the AuthWeave self-hosted development lab

conditions: Confirm the Cloud tier, region, deployed version and registered application settings.
A successful self-hosted development login does not verify this managed option.

evidence.summary: ZITADEL documents web, native and user-agent applications with authorization-code flows. Managed-service entitlement and configuration were not checked.

conditions: Confirm that the selected Cloud tier and deployed version expose the documented SCIM interface.
The documented native SCIM scope is the core User schema; do not infer group provisioning or enterprise-schema extensions.
Verify provisioning-domain isolation, attribute mapping and downstream application deprovisioning.

evidence.summary: The SCIM service-provider guide describes user creation, updates, deactivation and deprovisioning, with provisioning-domain isolation and a core-User-only schema limitation.

conditions: The documented native SCIM interface does not support Group provisioning.
This limitation does not prove that every alternative integration lacks group synchronization; any bridge needs separate evidence.

evidence.summary: The SCIM limitations section excludes Group provisioning. Broader group synchronization for the proposed Cloud configuration remains unknown.
